card.name: Inside long words before -ic/-ie endings
card.fires_on: Partway through a long word, just before an adjectival ending such as -ic, -ical, -ie or -ica. Seen in titles, scientific names and Latinate terms like Bibliographie, Cybernetics and californica.

modes.label: Foreign titles and names

modes.description: Inside Latin species names and technical words that end in -ica, -ics or -ic.
